mentions.name: Drawers
mentions.description: This macOS app gives each project its own dock, space, and set of windows. It integrates with macOS spaces to swap in a project-specific dock on each space, containing only the resources needed for that project, and supports adding granular resources (such as individual Slack channels) instead of full apps to keep the dock focused. A free beta download is available and beta testers are being sought.
mentions.problem: The native macOS interface mixes all projects together, causing distraction when trying to stay focused while working on the computer.
mentions.source_excerpt: We're working on Drawers (https://drawers.computer), a macOS app to give each of your projects its own dock, space, and windows.
